title: 芽苗沙漏
subject: a small friendly botanical hourglass timer with rounded honey-gold top and bottom caps, two short thick sage-green side supports, and a clear open hourglass-shaped center showing one broad warm-brown sand mound and one thick simple falling sand stream. A short sage two-leaf sprout rises from the top cap, and one small coral-red rounded timer button is inset in the base. This is an open matte game-item hourglass, no glass glare, no writing, no clockface, no tiny sand grains, no planter, no arrows

mechanical_operations.note: Canvas resize/centering only; original shading and alpha retained. No drawing, thickening, outlines or shape edits.
